mapper.sql: ec.id, ec.org_id, ec.claimant_member_id, ec.evidence_id, ec.expense_date, ec.amount, ec.currency, ec.status, ac.status AS approval_status, (ec.status = 'APPROVED' AND ad.status = 'CONFIRMED') IS TRUE AS posting_ready, ec.version, ec.created_at, ec.updated_at
LEFT JOIN approval_case ac ON ac.id = ec.approval_case_id AND ac.org_id = ec.org_id LEFT JOIN allocation_decision ad ON ad.id = ec.current_allocation_decision_id AND ad.org_id = ec.org_id

WHERE ec.org_id = #{organizationId}
AND ec.status = 'SUBMITTED' AND ec.status = 'NEEDS_INFO' AND ec.status = 'APPROVED' AND ec.status IN ('SUBMITTED', 'NEEDS_INFO', 'APPROVED')
